title: Steering strength as a dial for the safety-vs-coherence frontier

original_idea.body: Sweep steering strength for 3 safety concepts and plot the safety-gain vs coherence-proxy Pareto frontier with a knee point per concept.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Practical operating-point guidance but mostly methodological; chain to catastrophic-risk reduction is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Strength sweep + perplexity/quality proxy + Pareto plot; standard tools, ideal beginner first deliverable.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: Pareto frontier per concept with knee point.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public model, no internal access; reusable practical map the open community lacks, lab-deprioritized.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure inference sweep on one model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Steering-strength-vs-coherence is documented; mapping the full per-concept Pareto frontier is a partly-open synthesis.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Coherence degradation under steering is documented; the full per-concept safety-vs-coherence Pareto mapping may be partly open.
